name: temperage
description: Turns a design into an unpublished draft page in a Webflow site, brought to the site's existing template family: onboard, interview, approve a visual outline, build, never publish. Skill: webflow-template (/temperage:webflow-template in Claude Code and Cowork, selected by name in Claude.ai, $webflow-template in Codex). Ships .mcp.json for the Webflow MCP server. The catalog lives in your team's Confluence or Notion (or a working folder) and is mirrored into Webflow Agent Instructions.

source_of_truth.title: Source of truth
source_of_truth.description: Where the template catalog and run records live: one of confluence, notion, working-folder, downloads. Leave empty to be asked once, or to follow the pointer the site carries in its Agent Instructions.

confluence_space_key.title: Confluence space key
confluence_space_key.description: Only when the source of truth is confluence: the space that holds the webflow-template pages.

confluence_parent_page_id.title: Confluence parent page id
confluence_parent_page_id.description: Only when the source of truth is confluence: the page under which one page per catalog path is created.

notion_parent_page_id.title: Notion parent page id
notion_parent_page_id.description: Only when the source of truth is notion: the page under which one child page per catalog path is created.

working_folder.title: Working folder
working_folder.description: Absolute folder for the write-ahead copy of every record (and the source of truth itself when it is working-folder). Never inside the plugin directory. Leave empty to be asked once per machine.

instruction_prefix.title: Webflow instruction prefix
instruction_prefix.description: The Agent Instructions prefix the toolkit owns on each site.

allowed_stores.title: Allowed stores
allowed_stores.description: Which sources of truth a site's pointer block may select (confluence, notion, working-folder, downloads). Empty means any.

sites.title: Webflow site ids
sites.description: Sites this configuration applies to. Empty means any site.

tested_mcp_version.title: Tested Webflow MCP version
tested_mcp_version.description: The version string webflow_guide_tool returned when this configuration was last verified; preflight says so once when the live value differs.
